lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: What'd happen if he says something his story's different? Wh-he says he, he admits to doing it?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Like if his story's like different, like I never did nothin' or somethin'.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: What do you mean not really?

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: What do you mean by that? (pause) What do you mean by that Brendan? (pause) I have a question for yous two. Is there any way that I can talk to him. Not him, the other one.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: The only way we can have you talk to him is if he calls you or if its, you know, you go there for visiting.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA:
lines.text: I won't go there and visit.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: OK. That's the only way. I-I have no other way of, you know, I-I can't hook you up to him or anything like that. I'm not allowed to do that. If he calls you, you can do what you want or if you go there for visiting, you know that's up to you.
